rationale: This article examines US labor-market policies, government employment and training programs, monetary policy, and cyclical/structural unemployment. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings because the record is completely unrelated to water or sanitation (E01: US labor-market policies and unemployment programs).

evidence_quotes.quote: Potentials of Labor Market Policy: A View from the Eighties
A brief overview of US labor-market policies over the past 10 years is presented, and the effectiveness of government training and employment programs in reducing unemployment is evaluated.
